limitations: Uniform coupon draws, per-item independent post-draw loss; stationary time only; critical parameter c held fixed; no first-hitting-time or entry-process distribution result; independent audit not performed.
scientific_integrity: All stationary formulas are derived from an exact factorial-moment recursion; the critical limit and strict gap have analytic proofs. Finite rational tests are supporting checks, not a substitute for those proofs.
title: Exact stationary law and critical synchronization exponent for the careless coupon collector
